dedupe_keys.name: liscoast large scale integrated sea level and coastal assessment tool jrc collection of coastal hazard exposure and impact projections for europe and the world

description: LISCoAsT is the Joint Research Centre's integrated assessment tool for coastal flood hazards and impacts, whose outputs are grouped as a collection in the JRC Data Catalogue. The collection page read on 2026-09-28 (created 14 December 2018, modified 23 July 2026, contact Michail Vousdoukas) states its aims: dynamic scenarios of catastrophic coastal hazards such as storm surges and sea-level rise under climate change, scenarios of exposure and vulnerability in coastal areas, and a bottom-up, highly disaggregated assessment of climate impacts on coasts in Europe and worldwide. The Climate-ADAPT entry adds that the tool uses dynamic gridded projections of exposure and of all extreme sea level components, from mean sea level to tides and storm surges. Coverage is Europe and global coasts. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 unless otherwise indicated (European Commission reuse policy); individual JRC datasets may state their own terms. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the collection's dataset list failed to load with a page error, so the individual datasets, periods and formats were not read. It supports coastal flood exposure and adaptation studies, such as screening ports and coastal networks against future extreme sea levels. No related LISCoAsT dataset record is catalogued.
